company.name: EVUNITY
company.shortDescription: EVUNITY simplifies EV ownership with AI-powered automation for charging, maintenance, parts, and smart energy insights on one app.
company.description:
EVUNITY is your ultimate companion for managing electric vehicles (EVs) efficiently and conveniently. Designed to empower EV owners, businesses, and enthusiasts, EVUNITY offers a comprehensive platform that covers every aspect of EV ownership. Whether you're charging at home, navigating public charging networks, or searching for spare parts, EVUNITY brings everything you need into one seamless app.

Now powered by AI automation, EVUNITY takes your EV experience to the next level offering intelligent route planning based on real-time charging availability, predictive maintenance alerts, dynamic energy usage insights, and personalized recommendations. With EVUNITY, managing your EV is not just smart it’s automated, adaptive, and effortless.
